channel.title: Models & Agents for Beginners (Русский)
channel.description: AI for beginners and teens — daily episodes that explain how models and agents actually work, with free hands-on experiments you can try in minutes, no coding needed. Our sister show Models & Agents covers the expert builder view; this is the same AI universe explained for everyone. Every expert started exactly here.
